snippet.title: Seconds Till Destruction - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Kill everyone in six seconds! Seconds Till Destruction is a lightning fast, randomized top-down shooter. Use a massive array of guns and quick thinking to destroy humanity, one floor at a time! 

Coming out July 14th on Steam!
